import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col]
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[feats.y==1], x[feats.y==0])
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If no feature is significantly associated, return empty design
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05
    significant_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) if p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Check for correlation between features to avoid near-duplicates
    correlations = {}
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(significant_features):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(significant_features[i+1:], i+1):
            col1 = feats.column(fid1)
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                correlations[(fid1, fid2)] = corr
    
    # Remove one of each correlated pair (keep the one with higher effect size)
    to_remove = set()
    for (fid1, fid2), corr in correlations.items():
        # Use mean_y1 - mean_y0 as proxy for effect size
        col1 = feats.column(fid1)
        col2 = feats.column(fid2)
        mean_diff1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col1]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col1])
        mean_diff2 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col2]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col2])
        if abs(mean_diff1) < abs(mean_diff2):
            to_remove.add(fid1)
        else:
            to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    selected_features = [fid for fid in significant_features if fid not in to_remove][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # If no features left after filtering, return empty design
    if not selected_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check stratum consistency by fitting logistic regression within each stratum
    strata_consistent = True
    if len(set(feats.stratum)) > 1:
        # Fit model separately in each stratum and check if coefficients are consistent
        stratum_models = defaultdict(list)
        for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
            mask = np.array(feats.stratum) == stratum
            X_stratum = feats.x[mask][:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected_features]]
            y_stratum = feats.y[mask]
            
            # Standardize and fit logistic regression
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            X_stratum = scaler.fit_transform(X_stratum)
            lr = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, max_iter=1000)
            lr.fit(X_stratum, y_stratum)
            stratum_models[stratum] = lr.coef_[0]
        
        # Check if coefficients are similar across strata
        base_coef = list(stratum_models.values())[0]
        for coef in stratum_models.values():
            if np.linalg.norm(np.array(coef) - np.array(base_coef)) > 0.5:
                strata_consistent = False
                break
    
    # Return design based on whether strata are consistent
    if not strata_consistent:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build final design
    drivers = tuple(selected_features)
    columns = tuple(selected_features)
    
    # Add interaction terms for top 3 features (if enough features)
    products = ()
    if len(selected_features) >= 2:
        # Ensure products are valid feature IDs from feats.ids
        products = tuple((selected_features[0], selected_features[1]))
        if len(selected_features) >= 3:
            products += ((selected_features[0], selected_features[2]),)
    
    # Simple weighted score using top feature
    loadings = {selected_features[0]: 1.0}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
